WITH src AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4)
SELECT (SELECT min(calendar_date) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) AS p_start,
 (SELECT max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) AS p_end,
 (SELECT fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=4) AS loaded,
 count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl,
 min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx
FROM src

SELECT cs.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.format <> cs.format THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fmt_version_mismatch,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 OR f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpositive
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, SUM(r.receipts) AS receipts, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS net_before
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=4 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, (SELECT store_name||' '||format FROM dim_store x WHERE x.store_id=coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) AND x.is_current) AS nm,
  m.receipts, c.receipts AS ctl_receipts, m.net_before, c.net_before AS ctl_net,
  round(m.net_before-c.net_before,2) AS diff_net, m.receipts-c.receipts AS diff_rcpt
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE m.receipts IS NULL OR c.receipts IS NULL OR abs(m.net_before-c.net_before)>0.005 OR m.receipts<>c.receipts
ORDER BY 1

SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, st.format, st.open_date, st.close_date, st.is_current,

  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1 OR count(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)) AS odd_receipts
FROM dim_store st WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id<900 AND st.store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM sales)
